pipeline.title: Moderna’s norovirus vaccine plans in limbo in wake of phase 3 miss
pipeline.summary: Moderna has scrapped plans to enroll a new cohort in a phase 3 trial of its norovirus vaccine and instead will meet with regulators to decide on next steps.

pipeline.title: ANI makes $560M play for Egetis and its approved orphan drug Emcitate
pipeline.summary: ANI Pharmaceuticals is handing over $560 million to expand its rare disease business with the proposed buyout of Swedish drugmaker Egetis Therapeutics and its lead asset Emcitate, the first and only approved treatment for MCT8 deficiency.

pipeline.title: Rezera revs up for $181M IPO to fund phase 3 trial of NLRP3 inhibitor
pipeline.summary: Rezera—the new name for NodThera—is aiming for a $181 million IPO to take its NLRP3 inhibitor into phase 3 trials for a cardiovascular disease.

pipeline.title: MetaVia sees GLP-1 shed liver fat and body weight in phase 1, takes aim at specific liver disease
pipeline.summary: MetaVia has linked its GLP-1/glucagon receptor agonist to reductions in liver fat and body weight in a phase 1 trial. Encouraged by the data, MetaVia plans to start a phase 2 trial in alcohol-associated liver disease next year.

pipeline.title: Cloudbreak posts phase 3 eye disease win amid IPO storm
pipeline.summary: A phase 3 study of Cloudbreak Pharma’s eye disease drug candidate has hit its co-primary endpoints, boosting a biotech embroiled in an IPO investigation.

pipeline.title: AbbVie pens $1.4B deal for deprioritized IBD drug from Nxera
pipeline.summary: AbbVie has added another angle to its relationship with Nxera, with the Big Pharma paying $100 million upfront for a phase 1 inflammatory bowel disease candidate.

pipeline.title: Actor Jeremy Pope joins ViiV's 'PrEP Wisdom' campaign to educate on long-acting PrEP options
pipeline.summary: ViiV Healthcare has tapped a new mind for its “PrEP Wisdom” campaign, with Tony Award-winning actor and fashion icon Jeremy Pope joining in on the education and awareness messaging around long-acting injectable pre-exposure prophylaxis options.

pipeline.title: Novartis reveals cancer cases possibly linked to gene therapy Zolgensma
pipeline.summary: The occurrence of cancer in nine recipients — two of which involved evidence that a viral delivery tool integrated into patient DNA — could raise new questions for the gene therapy field.

pipeline.title: Moderna's COVID vaccine carries stellar Q3 revenue beat
pipeline.summary: Moderna posted $1.3 billion in third-quarter revenue, vastly surpassing analyst estimates and avoiding a predicted loss. The Q3 results suggest COVID can still make for a strong business plan.

pipeline.title: There's more than one way to build a biotech
pipeline.summary: Axiom Biosciences is taking an unconventional approach to raising capital and developing new therapies. In this episode of "The Top Line," founder and CEO Remo Moomiaie-Qajar joins Fierce Biotech's Marissa Russo to discuss the company's financing strategy, drug development approa

pipeline.title: Novartis confirms more reported tumor cases in Zolgensma patients as SMA groups seek details
pipeline.summary: Novartis has confirmed a number of new cases of tumors that developed in children treated with its gene therapy Zolgensma after a series of notices from spinal muscular atrophy advocacy groups this week.

pipeline.title: Lilly, Hims reach GLP-1 deal; Alnylam sales chief to step down
pipeline.summary: The deal is part of a course change for Hims, which had previously sold knockoff GLP-1 drugs. Elsewhere, a medicine Servier recently acquired failed a key trial and Ultragenyx announced staff cuts.

pipeline.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—Boehringer’s $7.4B SBP deal; Fresenius’ sweeping biosim pact; A $1B molecular glue bet
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim entered a potential $7.4 billion oncology-focused deal with China's SBP Group, as Fresenius formed a 37-asset biosimilar development collaboration with WuXi Biologics, and Evommune licensed an inflammatory disease molecular glue candidate from China's Hinova

pipeline.title: This week in charts: 3 drug launches Wall Street is watching
pipeline.summary: The latest installment in BioPharma Dive’s visualization-focused series features a look at investors’ response to a trio of medicines highlighted in quarterly earnings this week.

pipeline.title: Eli Lilly forces compounding rival to shed weight loss claims
pipeline.summary: Eli Lilly has successfully challenged Good Life Meds’ claims about the health benefits and personalization of a compounded tirzepatide product.

pipeline.title: Merck abandons Sutro-partnered IL-2 drug in ‘routine pipeline prioritization’
pipeline.summary: Merck & Co. has called time on a Sutro Biopharma-partnered IL-2 agonist that was being tested for solid tumors.

pipeline.title: Siemens Healthineers rebrands and carves out in vitro diagnostics biz
pipeline.summary: Siemens Healthineers will carve out its in vitro diagnostics business as a standalone company operating under the name Olyrian Diagnostics.

pipeline.title: Medicare will cut billions from 340B, expand site-neutral payments in 2027
pipeline.summary: Regulators finalized a rule Wednesday that would slash payments for drugs in the controversial 340B program and equalize some payments between care sites. Hospitals railed against the rule.

pipeline.title: Chutes & Ladders—Novo's longtime CFO to hang up gloves as Galderma exec steps in
pipeline.summary: Novo's CFO of the past 8 years is taking his leave at the end of the year. Alnylam is on the hunt for a new commercial chief amid news of Tolga Tanguler's departure. Amgen has looked within to replace its head of quality.

pipeline.title: At ASH, drugmakers to showcase early data for three-pronged cancer therapies
pipeline.summary: J&J and AbbVie are among the companies advancing “trispecific” antibodies that could become another step forward in treatment for multiple myeloma.

pipeline.title: Revolution’s Rasonque off to best cancer drug launch ‘in history’
pipeline.summary: Wall Street analysts are already resetting projections for Rasonque — but company executives cautioned that it’s too early to draw conclusions about the pancreatic cancer drug’s launch trajectory.

pipeline.title: Boehringer Ingelheim brings liver health education push to the NASCAR fast lane
pipeline.summary: "Driving Good Health" takes liver disease awareness to three NASCAR races this fall, with the last coming up at the Homestead-Miami Speedway Nov. 6 weekend.

pipeline.title: RevMed’s Rasonque debut nets ‘eye-popping’ $198M in 5 weeks, even as exec tempers expectations
pipeline.summary: After roughly one month on the market, Revolution Medicines’ RAS inhibitor daraxonrasib is living up to its much-hyped potential, with an initial sales performance that more than one group of analysts considers “eye-popping.”

pipeline.title: Generate CEO sees ‘huge opportunity’ from using Claude to shorten CAR-T cell engines
pipeline.summary: Generate Biomedicines' CEO has hailed the “huge opportunity” offered by AI tools after the Flagship-founded company used Anthropic's Claude AI platform to reduce the size of CAR-T cell engines.

pipeline.title: AstraZeneca said to offer $10B to acquire Rhythm, analysts whisper of a bidding war
pipeline.summary: AstraZeneca has made a roughly $10 billion offer to purchase rare obesity disease player Rhythm Pharmaceuticals, The Wall Street Journal reports. At least three teams of analysts suggest a bidding war could be brewing and that Rhythm is unlikely to settle for AZ’s current pitch.

pipeline.title: VintaBio assets go on auction block as CGT viral vector demand slows
pipeline.summary: VintaBio, which debuted in 2023 as a CDMO focused on cranking out viral vectors for cell and gene therapy production, is having its manufacturing facility and intellectual property put up for sale.

pipeline.title: Agios aims to shed over 100 R&D roles this year ahead of hoped-for sickle cell disease approval
pipeline.summary: Agios Pharmaceuticals has been shrinking its R&D headcount over the course of 2026 as the commercial-stage company looks to eliminate more than 100 roles by year-end.

pipeline.title: T-Therapeutics reloads with a $133M megaround for bispecifics
pipeline.summary: The startup is built around technology it claims can help get after known, but undruggable cancer targets and design particularly selective autoimmune disease treatments.

pipeline.title: Cash-strapped Vivoryon regains China rights to kidney disease prospect from Simcere
pipeline.summary: Vivoryon Therapeutics has regained the China rights to its kidney disease prospect as the German biotech’s cash reserves begin to dry up.

pipeline.title: Evommune signs $1B deal with China’s Hinova to enter same molecular glue niche as Novartis
pipeline.summary: Evommune has paid $30 million to China’s Hinova Pharmaceuticals to get stuck into a niche of preclinical molecular glue degrader development that’s also being pursued by Novartis.

pipeline.title: Alethio raises $90M to target rare blood cancers
pipeline.summary: The startup is working on a medicine one of its investors claimed could have a broader reach than other approved drugs for a group of conditions known as myeloproliferative neoplasms.

pipeline.title: Alnylam seeks new commercial leader as Tolga Tanguler exits amid faltering Amvuttra trajectory
pipeline.summary: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals is seeking a new chief commercial officer as the biopharma announced that its six-year CCO veteran, Tolga Tanguler, is leaving the company.

pipeline.title: Vanda drives straight into FDA trouble with fast-paced Nereus ad
pipeline.summary: Vanda Pharmaceuticals’ action-packed TV ad for motion-sickness drug Nereus has irked the FDA, which accused (PDF) the company of creating a misleading impression of the drug’s safety and effectiveness.

pipeline.title: Charles River teams up with Ipsen to use virtual control groups in toxicology studies
pipeline.summary: Charles River Laboratories’ virtual control group (VCG) database will be used in a toxicology study run by French biopharma company Ipsen.

pipeline.title: Sanofi stops development of Nurix-partnered immune drug
pipeline.summary: The decision sparked a sell-off in Nurix shares as well as analyst debate about the prospects of drugs designed to degrade a tough-to-reach protein called STAT6.

pipeline.title: Samsung Bio union vows strike as labor negotiations stall
pipeline.summary: Samsung Biologics' labor negotiations have stalled out amid mounting tension between union members and management. In response, the union says 400 employees will strike starting November 6.

pipeline.title: With oncology pipeline at ‘inflection point,’ Merck puts finish line in focus with new corporate campaign
pipeline.summary: In “From Our Pipeline to the Finish Line,” Merck highlights its vision of a cancer-free future and the role it hopes its pipeline will play in achieving that goal.

pipeline.title: Sanofi runs emotive RSV campaign zeroing in on a baby’s bronchiolitis breathing sounds
pipeline.summary: Would you know the difference between a normal cold and one that has turned into something more serious? Sanofi is raising awareness of bronchiolitis, a potential complication of RSV in young children, with a new a tough-to-watch PSA video.

pipeline.title: Novo gets much-needed lift as Wegovy pill tops Wall Street forecasts
pipeline.summary: The drug’s third-quarter sales numbers came in well above consensus estimates, widening Novo’s early edge over Eli Lilly in the latest battleground for weight loss medicines.

pipeline.title: Novo catches Wegovy pill tailwind in Q3 as CEO eyes new launch horizons in 2027
pipeline.summary: With a modest improvement to guidance and rosy launch expectations for 2027 girding a solid quarter for its GLP-1 franchise, Novo appears to be gradually winning back the confidence of some of its shareholders.

pipeline.title: Madrigal’s former clinical development head files whistleblower lawsuit alleging Rezdiffra safety cover-up
pipeline.summary: Madrigal Pharmaceuticals is facing a whistleblower lawsuit alleging that senior leadership censored serious liver-injury data related to its breakthrough MASH drug Rezdiffra and retaliated against the firm’s top clinical development head who tried to sound the alarm.

pipeline.title: BMS Canada teams with TANK Worldwide, Ogilvy Health to turn autumn leaves into melanoma awareness campaign
pipeline.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb Canada is partnering with TANK Worldwide and Ogilvy Health on a new “What Summer Leaves Behind” skin cancer awareness campaign.

pipeline.title: Minghui grants ASKA Japanese rights to sub-q TED candidate in $440M deal
pipeline.summary: China’s Minghui Pharmaceutical has licensed its late-stage thyroid eye disease candidate to ASKA Pharmaceutical for up to $440 million, granting the Japanese drugmaker exclusive development and commercialization rights in its home country.

pipeline.title: Blackstone Life Sciences teams up with Boston Scientific in $455M heart pump deal
pipeline.summary: Blackstone Life Sciences has penned a $455 million collaboration with Boston Scientific to co-fund the development of the medtech’s next-generation miniature heart pump system.

pipeline.title: Boehringer returns to Sino Biopharma in $7.4B deal for preclinical TCEs, ADCs
pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has returned to China to satisfy its appetite for antibody-drug conjugates and T-cell engagers.

pipeline.title: nPhase rakes in $30M to expand AI-native clinical data platform
pipeline.summary: Clinical research company nPhase has closed a $30 million series D financing round to expand its AI-native clinical data platform.

pipeline.title: Ultragenyx shrinks workforce and axes assets to halve R&D spend
pipeline.summary: Ultragenyx is laying off 20% of its workforce and axing drug development programs to cut its annual R&D budget to half of the amount it spent in 2025.

pipeline.title: Smith+Nephew held failed talks with J&J over potential orthopedics combination
pipeline.summary: Smith+Nephew held talks with Johnson & Johnson’s hip-and-knee replacement unit DePuy Synthes aimed at a potential combination with its orthopedics unit.

pipeline.title: Amgen's quality chief to retire as internal successor steps up
pipeline.summary: Jackie Elbonne, Ph.D., announced her retirement after 35 years in the biopharma industry, leaving Amgen's chief quality officer role to her deputy, Aine Hanly, Ph.D.

pipeline.title: Madrigal’s Rezdiffra storms past blockbuster milestone as CEO hails ‘accelerating’ MASH market
pipeline.summary: To Madrigal CEO Bill Sibold, “it’s hard to find a more attractive growth opportunity in biotech” than MASH, as the company’s Rezdiffra, the first FDA-approved MASH therapy, crossed the $1 billion mark in annual sales.

pipeline.title: T-Therapeutics raises $133M series B for bispecific pipeline with Big Pharma backers in tow
pipeline.summary: T-Therapeutics has pulled in a $133 million series B financing round that will be used to fund the biotech’s lineup of T cell receptor CD3 bispecific drug candidates.

pipeline.title: Pfizer delivers Q3 beat as post-COVID comeback gains momentum
pipeline.summary: Pfizer's third-quarter performance bested Wall Street estimates thanks to an Eliquis beat and 37% growth from acquired products.

pipeline.title: Rising Stars: Publicis Health’s Ariel Rabinowitz knows what it takes to 'meet people where they are'
pipeline.summary: Publicis Health’s Ariel Rabinowitz learned lessons about health literacy, trust and access firsthand while teaching at a school in the Bronx.

pipeline.title: Regulatory tracker: J&J pushes Rybrevant beyond lung cancer with new subQ FDA nod
pipeline.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

pipeline.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Foundayo sets new Rx record as Wegovy pill rebounds to prior high
pipeline.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Agios trims 100 R&D roles; Ultragenyx lays off 20%
pipeline.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker '26: Alethio attains $90M series A for rare blood cancer drugs
pipeline.summary: The Fierce Biotech Fundraising Tracker records venture capital rounds of $50 million or more secured by biotechs.
